# uzc_region (Data Source)

Looks up a single UzCloud region by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_region" "tashkent" {
  slug = "tashkent"
}

output "region_country" {
  value = data.uzc_region.tashkent.country
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cloud_provider_id` (String)
- `continent_code` (String)
- `continent_name` (String)
- `country` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`.
- `is_coming_soon` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `status` (Boolean)
- `uuid` (String) UzCloud's internal UUID for this region.
